title: Finite coefficient inverse image reflects K-flatness
statement: At each positive finite coefficient level for a prime l, finite extension E of Q_l and scheme X, let P be an etale cochain complex. If its intrinsic pro-etale inverse image is K-flat in the actual acyclic-total-tensor sense of [def-pc-kflat-complex], then P is categorical K-flat for quasi-isomorphisms. The inverse image and chain tensor maps are those of [def-sf-finite-coefficient-site-scalar-arrow] and [def-sf-finite-coefficient-site-chain-tensor].

source.place: Final site-transport paragraph; Stacks Project, Cohomology on Sites, Tags 06YN and 07A4.

proof.text: Exact faithful inverse image reflects acyclicity: use the homology comparison and faithfulness to reflect a zero identity. Carry out the argument over an arbitrary finite commutative coefficient ring before specializing it to the finite coefficient-extension ring; this shares the inverse-image and totalization data.

Apply intrinsic K-flatness to the inverse image of every acyclic etale complex. Transport the resulting acyclicity across the stated pointwise chain tensor comparison and reflect it back to the etale tensor.
Use the homotopy quotient acyclicity criterion and symmetry to recover categorical K-flatness on both sides.

theorem finiteHomNuKFlatReflection (n : ℕ)
    (P : CochainComplex (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u}
        (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))))) ℤ)
    (hP : @CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      X.ProEt inferInstance (essentiallySmallSelf.{0, u, u + 1} _)
      (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E X n)
      ((finiteHomNuComplex l E X n).obj P)) :
    (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso _ (.up ℤ)).kFlat P
